title: Family Members
description: Learn Tamil words for family members, including the elder/younger sibling distinction unique to Tamil.

exercises.explanation: 'Amma' and 'appa' are among the most affectionate words in Tamil — universally understood.

exercises.question: What does 'anna' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Anna' means elder brother. Tamil distinguishes elder (anna) from younger (thambi) brothers.
'Thangai' = younger sister. 'Akka' = elder sister. Tamil always specifies elder/younger for siblings.
Tamil has four separate words for siblings based on gender and age — older or younger relative to you.

exercises.sentence: En ___ peyar Ravi. (My father's name is Ravi.)
exercises.explanation: 'En appa peyar Ravi' = my father's name is Ravi. En = my, appa = father, peyar = name.
'Paatti' means grandmother — a word filled with warmth and affection in Tamil culture.
'En amma peyar Priya' = my mother's name is Priya. Word order: my + mother + name + Priya.

exercises.question: Which word means 'younger brother'?
exercises.explanation: 'Thambi' = younger brother. Also used casually to address any younger boy or young man.
